children.tooltip: Constitution +7: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Constitution +2: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Strength +7: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Strength.
Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Shatter +10: This effect gives a +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Stunning +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Vertigo +10: This effect gives a +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
Tendon Slice 10%: This effect gives a 10% chance to Hamstring the target for each attack that does damage.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
